terms.gloss: a decurion, commander of a squad of ten
terms.comment: In the Roman army the commander of a decuria of cavalry (Lewis & Short); Traupman uses it for a corporal.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 186.
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
